text:
Mei: seeing OOMs on merlin-14b canary after enabling prefetch + int4 quant. kv_alloc spikes then OOMs. anyone seen slot fragmentation like this? cc @Ryan @Sam
Sam: yup, reproduced locally with a small batch. collecting heap/kv stats now.
Gonzalo: quick thought — int4 packing changes layout; prefetch may be allocating more KV slots than runtime compacts, causing fragmentation. could be slot exhaustion rather than raw memory.
Ryan: can we try two quick experiments: 1) reduce default max_new_tokens for canary (1024->512) and 2) disable prefetch to see delta?
Mei: ran a short canary w/ prefetch OFF + max_new_tokens=512 — no OOM in ~1h. with prefetch ON + slot_shrink=1 still OOM after ~20m. logs excerpt:
```
[2025-06-10T15:12:03Z] kv_slots_used: 4896
[2025-06-10T15:12:18Z] kv_slots_used: 12132
[2025-06-10T15:12:18Z] OOM: unable to reserve KV slot
```
infra-bot: deploy merlin-14b/canary -> job/merlin-canary-3 FAILED and auto-rollback triggered.
Sam: attaching full traces in gist (link in thread). looks like slot count ramps during long-context sampling with prefetch.
Gonzalo: proposed plan:
- add periodic slot compaction in runtime (try safe compaction window)
- implement a KV-warmup limiter for prefetch so it doesn't reserve all predicted slots at once
- change merlin-14b quant/int4 default max_new_tokens to 512 until compaction lands
Ryan: also add a synthetic regression test that spawns long-context convo to catch this in canary.
Mei: I'll open PR to change the default config and add canary flag. Sam — can you run compaction patch in staging cluster?
Sam: will run compaction patch later today and report back. if staging looks clean we'll promote to dedicated and roll canary.
Mei: thanks — tagging the rollout checklist: we should also monitor token-level latency and cost impact of reducing max_new_tokens.
Ryan: :thumbsup: good. let's avoid a global change until we validate compaction works.
Mei: I'll update the merlin onboarding doc with the workaround and signal the QA team.
